title: Expose a Prometheus /metrics endpoint
body:
The observability stack scrapes each service's Prometheus /metrics endpoint; Apollo and Hermes already expose one. Hephaestus has none, so it is invisible to Prometheus and Grafana — no JVM health, no worker throughput, no failure rate.

Add GET /metrics on the existing HTTP port alongside /health, rendering the app CollectorRegistry. Use the same Prometheus simpleclient the sibling services use. A metrics.enabled toggle defaults to true; when disabled there is no route and a no-op recorder. Base JVM metrics plus worker metrics through a MetricsRecorder seam injected into the JobConsumer: jobs processed by lane and outcome, a processing-time histogram, and an in-flight gauge.
